title: An R interface to the ProteomeXchange repository
text: goal rpx package provide programmatic access proteomics data R, particular ProteomeXchange (Vizcaino J.. et al, 2014) central repository (see http://www.proteomexchange.org/ http://central.proteomexchange.org/). Additional repositories likely added future.

title: An R interface to the ProteomeXchange repository
text: central object handles data access PXDataset (version 2) class. instance can generated passing valid PX experiment identifier PXDataset() constructor.
code: library("rpx") id <- "PXD000001" px <- PXDataset(id) ## Loading PXD000001 from cache. px ## Project PXD000001 with 11 files ## ## Resource ID BFC7 in cache in /github/home/.cache/R/rpx. ##  [1] 'F063721.dat' ... [11] 'erwinia_carotovora.fasta' ##  Use 'pxfiles(.)' to see all files.

title: An R interface to the ProteomeXchange repository
text: Several attributes can extracted PXDataset projects, described . experiment identifier, originally used create project can extracted pxid() method: file transfer url data files can accessed can queried pxurl() method: species data generated data can obtain calling pxtax() function: Relevant bibliographic references can queried pxref() method: files available PX experiment can obtained pxfiles method: complete partial data set can downloaded pxget() function. function takes project instance first mandatory argument. next argument, list, specifies files download. missing, menu printed user can select file. set "", files experiment downloaded. One multiple file names, indices logicals can also used download specific files. rpx package makes use BiocFileCache package avoid repeatedly dowloading data. PXDataset projects created project files downloaded, stored package’s central user-defined cache. Next time project instantiated PXDataset() project file downloaded pxget(), existing artefacts retrieve cache, instead created/downloaded remote server . See ?rpxCache details caching.

text: Since version 1.99.1, rpx uses Bioconductor BiocFileCache package automatically cache downloaded ProteomeXchange files. file downloaded first time, added cache. already available, file path cached file directly returned. central rpx package chache, object class BiocFileCache, returned rpxCache(). Users can also provide cache object instead using default central cache pxget(). Since 2.1.1, PXDataset instances also cached using mechanism project files. PXDataset instance also stored project file names, reference, taxonomy sample project URL (see slot cache) instead accessing every time needed reduce remote access reliance stable internet connection. files, default cache returned rpxCache(), users can pass BiocFileCache objects. details manage cache (example files need deleted), please refer BiocFileCache package vignette documentation. See also rpxCache() additional details.
